headline: Toyota crush Barcelona to wrap up the WEC makers' title as Genesis fade from pole, Antonelli heads to Austin with a title in reach, China moves to put export curbs on its top AI models, and UFC 333 week begins in Abu Dhabi.

upcoming.what: ID@Xbox indie showcase, broadcast by IGN
Orionid meteor shower peaks; best after midnight, though moonlight will wash out the faint ones
F1 United States GP, Austin (standard weekend). Qualifying Sat 22:00, race Sun 20:00 Irish time. Antonelli could clinch the title
UFC 333, Abu Dhabi: Volkanovski vs Evloev, Yan vs Dvalishvili 3. Prelims ~15:00, main card ~19:00 Irish time
Irish clocks go back an hour
Ocarina of Time remake launches on Switch 2

items.headline: Toyota 1-2 in Barcelona seals an eighth WEC manufacturers' title
items.summary: The #8 of Buemi, Hartley and Hirakawa beat the sister #7 by just over half a second. The drivers' crown is now a straight fight between the two Toyota crews at the Monza finale.

items.headline: Genesis collapse from pole; Manthey Porsche wins LMGT3
items.summary: Juncadella ran wide at Turn 5 on the opening lap, and offs plus penalties left the Genesis cars 11th and 16th. In GT3 the #92 Manthey Porsche took its first class win of the year, cutting the TF Sport Corvette's lead to 18 points.

items.headline: Antonelli can be champion in Austin this weekend
items.summary: With a 102-point lead over Russell and six races left, Antonelli clinches if he wins and Russell finishes ninth or lower and Hamilton fifth or lower. Correction to yesterday: Austin is a standard weekend, not a sprint.

items.headline: UFC 333 fight week: Volkanovski vs Evloev in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Volkanovski defends featherweight gold against unbeaten Evloev on Saturday, with the Yan–Dvalishvili trilogy as co-main. Losene Keita steps in for Arnold Allen against Aaron Pico, and England's Lone'er Kavanagh faces Ramazan Temirov.

items.headline: Volkanovski promises to finish Evloev
items.summary: The champion says he'll stop Evloev inside five rounds, a pointed jab at a contender known for grinding out decisions.

items.headline: China proposes export controls on its top AI models
items.summary: A draft list of 40 technologies includes 23 AI items, among them frontier-scale models, agents, chip designs and compute clusters, with open-source work exempt. Firms must already register before exporting listed items; comments close 15 November.

items.headline: Germany set to unveil an industrial AI deal with Nvidia this week
items.summary: Government sources say the partnership, backed by federal funding, will focus on industrial uses like robotics and autonomous vehicles. Details are still to come.

items.headline: A tiny mirror tweak makes NASA's Roman telescope 30% better than planned
items.summary: Engineers nudged a mirror by a minute amount and the observatory now outperforms its design expectations.

items.headline: Webb spots surprisingly orderly weather on a world 20 light-years away
items.summary: Despite a turbulent environment, the planet shows an organised weather pattern, a neat test of how alien atmospheres behave.

items.headline: Altermagnetism, the 'third magnetism', takes a physics prize
items.summary: The newly recognised form of magnetism could underpin faster, more efficient computer memory. Orionids peak on Wednesday night.

items.headline: PS6 memory alone could cost over $680 per console, insider claims
items.summary: With RAM prices soaring, a hardware insider reckons next-gen consoles could top $1,000. Treat it as a claim, not a price.

items.headline: Samson studio Liquid Swords reportedly bankrupt
items.summary: The Swedish developer behind the open-world brawler has reportedly been declared bankrupt after months of unpaid wages.

items.headline: BioWare veteran warns CDPR's big sequels put it in a risky spot
items.summary: Anthem's former lead says ballooning budgets and sales expectations for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 put real pressure on the studio. No new Witcher 3 or Borderlands news this weekend.

items.headline: Quiet weekend on the mats
items.summary: No major pro grappling results since Friday. The Crown on 8 November remains the next big date.
